I added a 0.25s sleep after each request in `test_charges_roundtrip` in `tests/test_payments.py`. The delay is a `CALL_INTERVAL_S` constant at the top of the file. At 5 requests per second the minimum spacing is 0.2s, so 0.25s leaves some margin. I haven't run the test, so I don't know yet whether it fixes the CI flake.

The test makes four calls, so the sleeps add about 1 second. The sleep also runs after the last call, which isn't needed. I left it so the loop stays simple.

I also saved a note about the sandbox's 5 requests per second limit to EngramDB.
